answer: When the willow and the raven tell one story and the falcon tells another, believe the falcon: nurseries are harder to forge than names. Before the epoch the farm wires 143374 POA and sets aside 16464 minutes of labour, all sunk before any prize is counted. Give the epoch its backbone: Marionettemaker toy soldier warrant counted beside the market stall, shown by each toy soldier is a season of turned bench hours and a master record, judged by strangers who owe the applicant nothing. The proof holds because it is checked by people who gain nothing by letting it pass.
